synthesis.summary: Short-term ML signals remain strongly bullish, but the GEX regime has flipped to negative, shifting the market from a stabilizing to an accelerating environment. Combined with recent large flow activity, we expect increased price volatility despite current pinned vol.
synthesis.key_observation: GEX flip to negative changes market maker hedging behavior from stabilizing to volatility-accelerating.
synthesis.risk_flag: Increased risk of sharp, exaggerated moves due to negative GEX gamma profile.
